description: Source code for handling post-onboarding processes in RdkEasyMeshController, including policy configuration, channel scanning, onboarding status checks, and channel selection management.

methods.name: is_policy_config_required
methods.description: Checks if policy configuration is required, considering WFA certification status.

methods.name: is_initial_channel_scan_required
methods.description: Checks if initial channel scan is required, considering WFA certification status.

methods.name: chan_sel_query_compl_cb
methods.description: Callback for channel preference query completion, triggers channel selection request if successful.

methods.name: onboarding_status_check_timer_cb
methods.description: Timer callback to check onboarding status, sends config renew and topology query if needed.

methods.name: map_build_and_send_policy_config
methods.description: Builds and sends policy configuration request to an ALE.

methods.name: map_handle_policy_config_sent
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of policy config sent, updates radio and ALE states.

methods.name: map_build_and_send_initial_channel_scan_req
methods.description: Builds and sends initial channel scan request for a radio.

methods.name: map_handle_initial_channel_scan_request_sent
methods.description: Handles the event when initial channel scan request is sent, manages retries.

methods.name: map_start_onboarding_status_check_timer
methods.description: Starts or restarts the onboarding status check timer for an ALE.

methods.name: map_agent_handle_channel_selection
methods.description: Handles channel selection or query requests for an ALE and radio.

methods.name: map_agent_cancel_channel_selection
methods.description: Cancels ongoing channel selection or query timers for an ALE.
